Big Capital Does Not Fix Bad Risk Management

Large capital can create large exposure, and careless position sizing can turn an ordinary market move into a large loss. The amount of money involved is not the same thing as the quality of the decision. Strong processes start with defined risk, realistic expectations, and the ability to walk away from a market that does not fit the plan.

TRADING IS NOT FOR THOSE WHO DON'T HAVE PATIENCE.  LEARN | TRADE | EARN
